notes: Native-green 31-assertion representation and special-instance-identifier witness. Public Create/Join accepts reference types naming HLAobjectInstanceName with HLAunicodeString and HLAobjectInstanceHandle with HLAobjectInstanceHandle. Public Create rejects separate schema-valid unresolved simple/enumerated representations, an invalid special-identifier representation, and a raw basic representation for an ordinary reference. A valid retry checks federation-name reuse. Direct mappings are to clauses 6.2.15, 6.2.16, 6.2.17, and 4.14.9. The existing invalid-FOM corpus also covers the latter two rejection categories. Data-type introspection, broader table constraints, Java runtime, interoperability, and conformance are not claimed.
